title: The unlinked-criteria disclosure arrives after the seal that would have answered it
outcome: The unlinked-criteria disclosure arrives after the seal that would have answered it
acceptance: an author holding an item learns which acceptance criteria carry no evidence link while linking is still possible, not only in the completion receipt

completion.summary:
Under a self-asserted policy, the holder of an open item learns which criteria have no evidence link while linking is still possible:
- the holder's show JSON reports unlinked_criteria {count, positions ≤ 8};
- the holder's show and gate receipt carry one line, after the existing guidance: "criteria 1, 3 have no evidence link yet; link evidence in done, or pass the bound check first".
The predicate is shared with the seal (satisfied_binding), so a waived binding counts as unlinked exactly as the seal leaves it; a storage test pins the agreement. An evaluated policy shows neither, and a peer's show is unchanged. Docs: cli-and-mcp, local-work-system, shipped and acceptance-evaluation.
4 review rounds, the last clean of Medium and above, with its Low filed as w-17e7ab5be6fd. Gate 9/9 and the evaluation passed. Landed as c34c5a2 and installed as build 055bf12e.
